notes.title: Two Weeks Until the Release of Slay the Dragon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42021478/d1a2f28dc2058d6b7bdd3bedb18138aa0a8a8e56.png[/img]

We hope you didn't forget about your short stay in Cuca's swamp. We certainly didn't.

Two weeks remains until release of our new monster girl IP, set in an eerily familiar world. You'll definitely want to be awake for this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42021478/841dcdb3023d83db5cbe49426cda95901b656c16.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42021478/a6fab157a2e7b275b2d6a9d78be912aa84565c32.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42021478/7f6448266810a4628f461b4da132e160a5ca6ae1.png[/img]

Be sure to check out the game and give it a wish-list, if you haven't already. You won't be disappointed.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2558520/Slay_the_Dragon_The_FireBreathing_Tyrant_Meets_Her_Match/
